input: Make a scrapbook of last summer's road trip

gold.taskTitle: Make a Scrapbook of Last Summer's Road Trip
gold.taskDescription: Create a physical or digital scrapbook documenting memories, photos, and mementos from last summer's road trip.

questions.title: Will this scrapbook be physical or digital?
questions.description: Understanding the format determines the tools, materials, and platforms needed for the project.

questions.title: How many photos do you plan to include?
questions.description: Knowing the volume of photos helps estimate the size, page count, and scope of the scrapbook.

questions.title: Where are your road trip photos currently stored?
questions.description: Photos may be on a phone, camera, cloud service, or scattered across multiple devices, affecting how they need to be gathered.

questions.title: Do you have physical mementos to include, like tickets or maps?
questions.description: Items such as ticket stubs, receipts, postcards, or maps may be incorporated as physical elements or scanned for a digital version.

questions.title: Who is the scrapbook intended for or being shared with?
questions.description: Whether it is personal, a gift, or shared with travel companions shapes the tone, content, and level of detail.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target completion date?
questions.description: A timeframe helps structure the work into manageable steps and set realistic milestones.

questions.title: Do you have a budget for supplies or printing services?
questions.description: Budget affects choices around materials, scrapbook kits, professional printing, or digital app subscriptions.
